name: base1-parasite-rail-spacing
scope: Prepared single Parasite; retreat before acquisition, settle then Railgun damage at >=320. No simultaneous retreat shot or long-range moving-target acceptance.
acceptance: Loaded Shotgun and fresh inventory at automatic Railgun request
At least two actual away steps during needed retreat before Railgun aim settles
Attack suppressed during aim settling, then at least two firing command frames at >=320 distance and <=0.5 degree command error
Positive native MOD_RAILGUN damage and exactly one selected-weapon kill
No death or later give/teleport; campaign travel resumes after kill
Timescale2, independent parallel servers/clients, distinct acknowledged seeds and unchanged source fingerprint
